title: Trade review 16 Nov: 3 results, 5 lessons
summary: 0 T2, 3 T1 (partial wins), 0 failed: CPPLUS +3.55%, SBICARD +2.77%, TATAPOWER +1.35%. 87 closed trades now total +172.0%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Mon 16 Nov:** 3 trades closed at 30 days with a profit, nothing failed, room-filter lesson dropped.

Three 30-day exits, all in profit after booking T1 earlier: together +7.7 points. All 87 closed trades now total +172.0% (average +2.0%), against +164.4% from 84 on Friday. Nifty rose 0.58% to 25,291.10. 15 trades are still running, 12 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 102 bought trades is +1.2%. No new buys today; one new pick (CHENNPETRO) was listed. The next 30-day exits are FINCABLES (−7.7%) and VMM (−1.2%) on 18 Nov, then AEGISLOG (−6.8%) on 20 Nov.

**Today's results**

- ✅ **CPPLUS** (Retest, listed 15 Oct): closed at 30 days, partial win: Bought at ₹4,100.10 on 16 Oct, T1 was reported on 6 Nov; half sold at T1 ₹4,343.32 and half at today's close, an average exit of ₹4,245.66, +3.55%, back from a −11.73% dip. It traded 5.9% cheaper inside the entry window. It rose 12% in the month before listing, yet still made money.
- ✅ **SBICARD** (Candle at support, listed 15 Oct): closed at 30 days, partial win: Bought at ₹573.20 on 16 Oct, T1 was reported on 12 Nov; average exit ₹589.09, +2.77%, back from a −9.45% dip. It traded 4.0% cheaper inside the entry window, and a zone-bottom buy at ₹565.45 would have made +4.18%.
- ✅ **TATAPOWER** (Candle at support, listed 14 Oct): closed at 30 days, partial win: Bought at ₹350.95 on 15 Oct, T1 was reported on 5 Nov; average exit ₹355.68, +1.35%, worst dip −5.06%. It never dipped to the zone bottom, so that rule would have missed it.

Plus 60 earlier, among them IDFCFIRSTB, NMDC, SUNDARMFIN, PFC and TMPV (11 Nov). These 70 wins (55 at T2, 15 partial) made +353.5%; with the 17 failures (−181.5% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%; four of them are liquid ETFs that closed flat) all 87 closed trades total +172.0%. 7 of the 15 partial 'wins' lost money; today's three all made money. T1 booked, rest still open (6): GRANULES (12 Nov), LUPIN (9 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct). 4 of these 6 are below their buy price (ASTRAL −8.4%, ESCORTS −8.5%, PNGSREVA −7.8%, GRANULES −0.2%).

**Missed and better entries**

- **Room-filter near misses lost on money in their first 30-day cohort:** The 14 near misses bought by 16 Oct have all closed: 5 at T2, 3 failed (APARINDS −17.0%, TEGA −14.1%, CASTROLIND −3.0%), total +7.1 (average +0.5%). The 10 real picks bought 14–16 Oct made +32.5 (average +3.3%), with 5 at T2 and 2 failures, one of them a flat ETF. A small first sample, but it matches the hit rates.
- **Missed winners still 19 of 31:** None new tonight. 23 of the 31 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, a little more money:** Fills 93% vs 80% as listed: 13.9 points (the bar is 15). Its 103 closed trades made +201.3%, against +172.0% from 87 as listed, with 21 losing trades against 20.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.6% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 101 closed trades made +230.9% with 16 losing trades; average closed trade +2.6% against +2.0%.

**Lessons**

- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −2.9% (closed and open), and their 24 closed trades net −68.6% with 11 of the 17 failures. Off the list since 4 Nov. The 10 retest near misses logged since then: 5 at T1, 2 at T2, best rise 3.9% on average. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** All 13 real failures came from stocks that rose 5% or more in the month before listing; the other 4 failures are flat liquid ETFs. Those 38 trades average −3.3% and their 32 closed trades net −106.4%; the other 64 made +278.4% from 55 closed trades, 42 at T2. Fifth review in a row, but it uses my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change yet. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 37 of 41 bought reached T1 (90%) and 30 reached T2 (73%); their 35 closed trades made +178.0% with 3 failures (CENTUM, WABAG and a flat LIQUIDBEES), and they dip least (−4.3%). (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 19 of 31 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open; 23 of the 31 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys sit close to T1, so the wins are small, about +3.9% each. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** Dropped tonight, as promised on Thursday: its near misses trail the real picks on T1 (69% vs 75%) and T2 (52% vs 54%), and in the first cohort to reach 30 days they made +0.5% a trade against +3.3% for the real picks. (dropped)

Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 15, 53%) and those dip −9.4%. F&O stocks reach T2 more than twice as often as cash stocks (76% vs 34%) and dip far less (−3.5% vs −11.4%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+230.9% vs +172.0%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2; zone up to 2% above gets 13.9 points more fills against a bar of 15. The run-up lesson is the strongest (13 of 13 real failures), but the 5% line is my own and the tracker has no group for the month-before return, so it stays a lesson. Dropping the room-filter lesson supports keeping that filter as it is.

**🐞 Bugs found:** one small one. The zone-bottom what-if for LIQUID1 (listed 29 Sep) changed from a closed 'Failed' (+0.62%) on Friday to 'Waiting for entry' tonight, which is impossible 48 days after listing; it moved the zone-bottom row from 55 to 54 trades. The real trade is unchanged. Sent to the scan's owner. Everything else checks out: 102 bought = 55 at T2 + 15 partial + 17 failed + 15 running; T1 hit 76 ≥ T2 hit 55; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit; no closed row changed.
